create_blt_tokenizer: create a BltTokenizer instance with optional BPE delimiter and BOS/EOS token settings
encode_text_to_tokens: encode a text string into a list of integer tokens using the BltTokenizer
decode_tokens_to_text: decode a list of integer tokens back into a UTF-8 text string using BltTokenizer
get_vocab_size: get the total vocabulary size of the BltTokenizer including offsetting special characters
convert_hex_bytes: convert a hex string like <0x4865> or plain text into raw bytes using convert_to_bytes
